{"claims":[{"claim_text":"The Trump Administration has treated Africa and its people with neglect and contempt.",
"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will repair relationships with African partners and publics.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will renew commitment to fight for democracy and human rights in Africa.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will advance peace and security in Africa.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will bolster economic growth and public health in Africa.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will promote clean energy, sustainable agriculture, environmental protection, and decent work for all in Africa, with special regard for youth and women.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will recommit to the Obama-Biden Administration's National Strategy for Combating Wildlife Trafficking.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will ban importation into the United States of hunting trophies from Africa's iconic and endangered big cats.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will seize opportunities to strengthen fragile political transitions in Sudan and Ethiopia.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will deepen relations with key partners in Africa.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will not shirk from longstanding pledge to assist countries in Central Africa, the Sahel, and the Horn of Africa to counter extremism and address root causes of insecurity.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will support the implementation of the African Union's African Continental Free Trade Agreement and its Agenda 2063.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will promote a multi-faceted economic engagement focused on increasing two-way and regional trade, promoting investment and partnership in key industries in Africa.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will assist in Africa's recovery from the COVID-19 pandemic.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will expand efforts to improve the resiliency of health systems across the continent of Africa.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Africa is home to some of the world's fastest growing economies.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Africa's population will roughly double to more than two billion by the middle of this century.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Nigeria is projected to have the third largest population in the world.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"American diplomacy can play a critical role in helping ensure that the region's vulnerabilities to climate change and pandemic disease—and persistent challenges of regional conflict, illicit financial flows, poor governance, and food, water, and health insecurity—do not overwhelm its enormous opportunities.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[1]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
